Title 2: Register with email and confirm address
Description: As a customer I can register with name, email and a strong password and confirm my email.
Acceptance Criteria: Weak passwords rejected inline; verification email sent; unverified users cannot start a session.

Title 2: Sign in, Google SSO and session restore
Description: As a customer I can sign in with email or Google and stay signed in.
Acceptance Criteria: Safe error messages; Google works via Credential Manager; session restored after restart; logout works.

Description: As a customer I can reset or change my password.
Acceptance Criteria: Reset email sent; change requires current password; Google-only accounts see a clear message.

Description: As a guest I can browse and filter the 10 services.
Acceptance Criteria: Search by name/description; filter All/Sofa/Leather/Auto/Chairs; prices in rand; empty/loading/error states.

Description: As a customer I can open a service and start a booking.
Acceptance Criteria: Details show duration and 'from' price; guests are sent to sign-in and returned to the same booking form.

Description: As a customer I can request a booking.
Acceptance Criteria: Date tomorrow+ (Africa/Johannesburg); times 08:00-16:00; address 5-200; terms accepted; unique reference shown after commit; no duplicates on retry.

Description: As a customer I can see Upcoming/Past and cancel Pending bookings.
Acceptance Criteria: Upcoming/Past rules; confirm dialog; Cancelled persisted; cancellation notification; cannot cancel twice.

Description: As a customer I see and manage notifications.
Acceptance Criteria: Newest first; unread dot/count; mark one/all read; delete; persists.

Description: As a customer I can edit profile, preferences and theme.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation; persistence after force-stop; theme System/Light/Dark; permission handling API 33+.

Title 2: Six-table Room database with 10+ records each
Description: As the developer I can demonstrate stored data.
Acceptance Criteria: FKs/indices/unique constraints; fixtures give >=10 rows per table; counts verified in Database Inspector.

Description: As a customer my data is hidden from other accounts on the same phone.
Acceptance Criteria: All private queries scoped to verified UID; account A cannot read or cancel account B's rows.

Description: As a team we build and test on every PR.
Acceptance Criteria: Unit tests, lint, assembleDebug; artifacts uploaded; instrumentation job runs.

Description: As a user I have help and guides.
Acceptance Criteria: In-app Help (10+ FAQs), README, user guide, architecture, test plan.

Description: As a student I submit a professional demo.
Acceptance Criteria: Recorded on real phone with voice-over; shows features, DB data, CI and board; no secrets visible.
